title: BONDERITE® S-ST 6776 LOW ODOR AERO – 5 GAL
description: Thixotropic, acid liquid used to remove such resistant finishes as polyurethanes, epoxies, epoxy primers and similar catalyzed paints from aluminum, mild steel and titanium. Not for use on high-strength steel or magnesium. Applied by spray, flow-on or brush techniques. No chlorinated solvents. MIL-R-81903.
